issues.description: Problem statement requires calling an external function `exit_func` with an integer status code on termination, but the solution calls `exit_func` without passing any argument (no push of a status code). This makes the solution inconsistent with the specification and could confuse students who expect the reference implementation to demonstrate the required call convention/argument passing.
issues.suggested_fix: Update the solution so it passes an integer status code according to the calling convention before calling exit_func. For example, add a push of a status code (e.g. `push dword 0`) immediately before `call exit_func`, and keep the `extern exit_func` declaration. This ensures the solution matches the problem requirement to call exit_func with an integer status code.
